C9000182.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 182 (Power savings for intersective polynomial differences and prime arguments.; papers: A power saving for intersective polynomial differences with an exponent depending only on the degree; A Power Saving for Polynomial Differences at Prime Arguments; A power saving for square-difference-free sets; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/182.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

WTC_VERIFY.statement: All-parameter homogeneous directed-kernel tuple theorem and specialization to the actual weighted constructions.

WTC_GRAPH.statement: Directed graph counting and bipartite operator bounds without edge-reversal symmetry.

WTC_MARKED.statement: Strict positive marked-cut index kernel, with the exact half-index normalization and no distinct-label assumption.

WTC_BRIDGE.statement: Directed factor inclusion under the genuine entry bijection and the exact independent restriction factor r^(-n).

WTC_MIXTURE.statement: Cut pairing, positive normalization, negligible terminal mass, directed cycle support and uniform one-slot marginals.

WTC_CONDITIONAL.statement: Squared conditional contraction bounded by Clead*epsilon^(1/2)+Cmass*q for full and nonterminal laws.

WTC_FORMAL_CORE.statement: Lean 4.31.0 universal combinatorial marking core; compiler success is recorded, independent statement-fidelity approval is pending.

WTC_SPECIALIZATION.statement: The original q=p^(-delta/2), epsilon=p^(-4delta) coefficients satisfy explicit all-large-prime bounds uniformly in l under the three stated local hypotheses; allowed-regular weights obey the same construction theorem.

WTC_SHARPNESS.statement: For the actual constant-one-kernel mixtures on large even alphabets, squared conditional contraction is at least c(L,t)*q; the square-root marking term cannot be removed.

WTC_PUBLICATION_REVIEW.statement: Independent review of the all-parameter proof, formal statement fidelity, novelty and publishable significance; no main power-saving theorem or zero-free theorem is certified here.
